part.name: Lever arm with blind cylindrical pivot socket

part_functions.name: Levered load transfer
part_functions.function: The elongated plate acts as a lever or handle, carrying bending and torsional loads between its long arm and the cylindrical interface boss.

part_functions.name: Blind cylindrical connection
part_functions.function: The boss provides a blind, Y-axis cylindrical socket for locating and retaining a mating pin, shaft, or tool shank while the surrounding wall reacts radial loads.

sections.name: Elongated arm body at x=-25 to 80

section_functions.name: Structural span
section_functions.function: A 4 mm thick plate spanning primarily along X transfers bending and torsional loads. It is integral with the boss transition near x=0 and terminates in a curved end at negative X.

section_functions.name: Boss support
section_functions.function: The broad plate surfaces and sidewalls support the transverse boss and spread loads from its blended junction into the long arm.

features.name: Constant-thickness plate and straight free end

feature_functions.name: Primary load-bearing member
feature_functions.function: The opposed Z-normal faces form the main bending section; the Y sidewalls and x=80 end face close the plate. The plate is adjacent and integral to the boss blend along its y=23 side.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Short y=23 upper sidewall segment between the rounded negative-X end and the boss blend.
Broad bottom plate face at z=2, following the complete arm outline around the boss junction.
Long straight sidewall at y=11 extending from x=-25 to x=80.
Broad top plate face at z=6, following the complete arm outline around the boss junction.
Rectangular terminal end face at x=80 closing the straight end of the arm.
Long y=23 sidewall extending from the positive-X side of the boss blend to the x=80 end.

feature_functions.name: Smooth arm termination
feature_functions.function: The large-radius curved edge closes the negative-X end of the plate, removes sharp external corners, and provides a gradual terminal profile adjacent to the arm sidewalls and broad faces.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Large-radius cylindrical side surface forming the rounded negative-X end of the 4 mm thick plate.

sections.name: Transverse socket boss near x=0 on the y=23 side

section_functions.name: Mating-member interface
section_functions.function: The boss is aligned along Y and presents a blind cylindrical cavity from y=34 toward y=25 for insertion and radial location of a mating cylindrical member.

section_functions.name: Interface load distribution
section_functions.function: The thick outer boss wall carries radial contact loads from the socket, while the smooth blended base distributes those loads into the adjacent plate and reduces junction stress concentration.

features.name: Outer cylindrical boss with blended root

feature_functions.name: Socket reinforcement
feature_functions.function: The radius-7 outer cylinder concentrically surrounds the radius-5 socket and supplies wall thickness for radial load capacity.

feature_functions.name: Load-spreading junction
feature_functions.function: The BSpline root is adjacent to the cylindrical boss and merges it continuously into the plate near y=19 to 24, spreading local boss loads into the arm.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Bulbous blended root surface joining the boss around x=0 to the plate across y=19 to 24.
Radius-7 outer boss wall coaxial with the socket along the Y axis and extending to the front rim at y=34.

feature_functions.name: Radial location
feature_functions.function: The radius-5 cylindrical wall locates a mating pin or shaft radially and is coaxial with the radius-7 outer boss.

feature_functions.name: Axial stop and retention
feature_functions.function: The circular floor at y=25 provides an axial insertion stop, while the annular face at y=34 forms the socket entrance and bearing rim.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Circular planar floor at y=25 closing the inner end of the blind socket.
Radius-5 internal cylindrical socket wall extending along Y from the blind floor to the opening.
Annular front rim at y=34 between the radius-5 socket and radius-7 outer boss wall.
